page.title: Imprint Random Walk NFT
page.subtitle: Own a Random Walk NFT and receive a 50% reduction in ETH Gesture Cost
page.description: RandomWalk NFTs are unique digital collectibles that grant holders a strategic advantage in the Cosmic Signature protocol. By attaching a RandomWalk NFT to an ETH gesture, you receive a 50% reduction in ETH Gesture Cost - a significant edge late in the cycle. Each RandomWalk NFT can be used once for this discount, so choose your moment wisely for maximum impact. This gesture attachment is separate from anchoring RandomWalk NFTs for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility.
